definitions.explanation: A boundary or endpoint. Almost always used in the negative pattern 際限がない or 際限なく to mean "without limit" or "endlessly."

examples.japanese: ⟦{欲望|よくぼう}→欲望：05086_yokubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{際限|さいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{際限|さいげん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てしまう。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{際限|さいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}しましょう→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: This debate has no end, so let's reach a conclusion soon.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧ (edge/boundary) + {限|げん} (limit). Overwhelmingly used in the negative.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {際限|さいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there is no limit; limitless)
- {際限|さいげん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without limit; endlessly)
- {際限|さいげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (limitless; unbounded)

USAGE:
Rarely if ever used in the affirmative. You would not normally say {際限|さいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧. Instead, this word's function is almost entirely as part of the negative pattern expressing limitlessness. Similar to how the English word "cessation" mainly appears in the phrase "without cessation."
